source.name: NBA Communications (pr.nba.com): BAL and Rwanda Development Board multi-year extension
source.quote: Through the agreement, Visit Rwanda will continue to be showcased on BAL team uniforms and at the BAL Combine.
source.note: Multi-year extension covering BAL playoffs and finals in 2026; the BAL's March 2026 PUMA announcement confirms RDB remains a Foundational Partner in the 2026 season.

source.name: The BAL (bal.nba.com): BAL names PUMA as league's official outfitter ahead of 2026 season
source.quote: will see PUMA supply all official BAL team, fan and referee apparel, including game uniforms
source.note: League-wide outfitter deal from the 2026 BAL season: PUMA supplies the game uniforms of all BAL teams, including Petro de Luanda. Season 6 game photos (BAL highlight thumbnails on bal.nba.com) show the PUMA mark on Petro's jersey; no club-level shirt sponsor is visible.

summary: League-controlled branding only: Visit Rwanda is carried on all BAL uniforms and PUMA is the BAL's official outfitter from the 2026 season. BAL Season 6 game photos of Petro de Luanda's yellow home jersey show no club-level shirt sponsor.
